name: 50_KMH_WHEN_LIGHTS_FLASHING_YELLOW_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. W8-SA110 1060 x 770, R50, 10 / 30. 50 in 280 E, baseline 345, 510 wide (60 from the left); 24 gap; km/h 120 E lower case, 406 overall, on the same baseline (60 from the right) — k, m, the oblique stroke and h placed where the sheet draws them (the stroke, 180 tall, as a parallelogram on the sheet's ink). WHEN LIGHTS 100 D baseline 530 (185 below), 845 overall (110/W 845 S/105; word gap set to span it); FLASHING 100 D baseline 705 (175 pitch, 65 below), 615 (225/615/220). For 80 km/h locations (see TES 19975); the value is fixed — no variants.
